notes_for_editor: Only one source places a tower named rockingham here: the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (GA287), whose page carries a March 2016 revision stamp. The record's register numbers (BLL US 65212, GFC US 522) and the list's usgs tag come from that same line; the list does not define the abbreviations on the page read. Elevation is listed as 191 with no unit (the record's 58.2 m corresponds to feet). The record's status and access stay unknown: no source found describes build date, design, height, staffing, fires, fate or the site today. Two searches and the NHLR/FFLOS crawl cache had no Georgia entry for this tower; firelookout.org's Georgia page is marked under construction. Worth a human check with the Georgia Forestry Commission (Alma office or property division) before any status change. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the tnlandforms.us home page carries unrelated gambling spam text, so the site may have been tampered with; the Georgia list page itself shows none. The name Tom Dunigan appears on the home page ("Tom Dunigan's old UT home page"), not on the list page.
